description: Create an objective under a pillar. Rejects a pillarId that does not exist. Nothing rolls up to a new objective until a cluster is tagged with it via anyforge_update_theme. Requires `write` scope.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

ownerUid.description: Accountable owner, as a user id.

statement.description: The objective, e.g. "Grow fast, without depending on any single client."

name: anyforge_create_objective
title: Create objective
